purpose: MATCH logical services and exposed operations
statement: MATCH (s:Service)-[:EXPOSES]->(o:Operation) WHERE s.graph_id=$graph RETURN s.name AS service, o.name AS operation, o.protocol AS protocol ORDER BY service, operation

MATCH p=(w:BusinessWorkflow {id:'wf-rec'})-[:USES_OPERATION]->(:Operation)-[:CALLS*1..2]->(o:Operation) WHERE w.graph_id=$graph RETURN o.name AS target, length(p)-1 AS call_hops, [r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r)='CALLS' | r.condition] AS conditions ORDER BY call_hops,target

purpose: Archived runtime hierarchy, without claiming causality
statement: MATCH p=(a:Observation {id:'obs-archive-span-00003'})-[:PARENT_OF*1..4]->(b:Observation) WHERE a.graph_id=$graph RETURN b.name AS observation, b.original_operation AS operation, b.outcome AS outcome, length(p) AS trace_hops ORDER BY trace_hops

purpose: Research query: unresolved business dependency claims and their source
statement: MATCH (a:Operation)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Operation) WHERE a.graph_id=$graph UNWIND d.evidence_ids AS evidence_id MATCH (e:Evidence {id:evidence_id}) RETURN a.name AS caller,b.name AS dependency,d.criticality AS criticality,d.condition AS condition,d.verification_status AS verification,e.locator AS source ORDER BY caller

purpose: Resolve an observation to the preserved original record
statement: MATCH (i:Incident)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation)-[p:DERIVED_FROM]->(e:Evidence) WHERE i.graph_id=$graph RETURN o.original_record_id AS record,o.outcome AS outcome,p.json_pointer AS pointer,e.locator AS file,e.sha256 AS sha256 ORDER BY record

purpose: Identify name joins that lack deployed-source version confirmation
statement: MATCH (o:Observation)-[r:OBSERVED_AT|INVOKES]->(p:Operation) WHERE o.graph_id=$graph AND r.version_match='unverified' RETURN o.original_record_id AS record,p.name AS operation,r.mapping_basis AS join_basis,r.version_match AS version_status ORDER BY record

purpose: Neo4j Browser graph visualization of the source-only recommendation slice
statement: MATCH (w:BusinessWorkflow {id:'wf-rec'})-[u:USES_OPERATION]->(entry:Operation) MATCH p=(entry)-[:CALLS*0..2]->(o:Operation) OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Service)-[owns:EXPOSES]->(o) RETURN w,u,p,s,owns

purpose: Neo4j Browser graph visualization of the preserved trace
